title: 線上學習
description: 線上課程與遠端學習用語

sentences.en: The online lecture, which was originally scheduled for ten o'clock, has been postponed due to technical difficulties with the platform.
sentences.zh: 原定十點的線上講座因為平台技術問題已被延後。

sentences.en: Please make sure your microphone is muted when you are not speaking, as background noise can be very distracting for others.
sentences.zh: 請確保你不說話時麥克風是靜音的，因為背景噪音對其他人來說可能非常干擾。

sentences.en: The instructor has uploaded all the course materials to the learning management system, including recorded lectures and supplementary readings.
sentences.zh: 講師已將所有課程材料上傳到學習管理系統，包括錄製的講座和補充閱讀資料。

sentences.en: I am having trouble connecting to the virtual classroom because my internet connection keeps dropping every few minutes.
sentences.zh: 我連接虛擬教室有困難，因為我的網路連線每幾分鐘就斷一次。

sentences.en: The discussion forum on the course website provides an excellent opportunity to exchange ideas with classmates from different time zones.
sentences.zh: 課程網站上的討論區提供了一個與不同時區同學交流想法的絕佳機會。

sentences.en: Could you please share your screen so that everyone in the meeting can see the document you are referring to?
sentences.zh: 你能分享你的螢幕嗎，這樣會議中的每個人都能看到你提到的文件。

sentences.en: The self-paced nature of this online course allows students to complete the modules at a speed that suits their individual schedules.
sentences.zh: 這門線上課程的自定進度特性讓學生可以按照適合個人時間表的速度完成各模組。

sentences.en: I find it much harder to stay focused during virtual lectures, especially when there are so many distractions at home.
sentences.zh: 我發現在虛擬講座期間保持專注困難得多，特別是家裡有這麼多令人分心的事物。

sentences.en: The breakout rooms feature enables the professor to divide students into smaller groups for more intimate and productive discussions.
sentences.zh: 分組討論室功能使教授能夠將學生分成較小的小組，進行更親密且有成效的討論。

sentences.en: All assignments must be submitted through the online portal before midnight on the due date, regardless of your local time zone.
sentences.zh: 所有作業必須在截止日期午夜之前通過線上入口提交，無論你所在的時區。

sentences.en: The webinar that we attended last Thursday featured a guest speaker who is considered one of the leading experts in artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我們上週四參加的網路研討會邀請了一位被認為是人工智慧領域頂尖專家的客座講者。

sentences.en: I appreciate the flexibility that online learning offers, but I genuinely miss the face-to-face interactions with my classmates and professors.
sentences.zh: 我很欣賞線上學習提供的彈性，但我真的很想念與同學和教授面對面的互動。

sentences.en: The video conferencing software crashed in the middle of our group presentation, which caused us to lose several minutes of our allotted time.
sentences.zh: 視訊會議軟體在我們小組報告中間當機了，這導致我們損失了幾分鐘分配的時間。

sentences.en: Students who experience technical issues during the live session can access the recorded version, which will be available within twenty-four hours.
sentences.zh: 在直播課程期間遇到技術問題的學生可以觀看錄影版本，它將在二十四小時內可用。

sentences.en: The online quiz has a strict time limit of forty-five minutes, and you will not be able to pause or resume once you begin.
sentences.zh: 線上測驗有嚴格的四十五分鐘時間限制，一旦開始就不能暫停或繼續。

sentences.en: I would recommend turning on your camera during class, as it helps create a more engaging and interactive learning environment.
sentences.zh: 我建議上課時開啟你的攝影機，因為這有助於創造更投入和互動的學習環境。

sentences.en: The digital whiteboard tool allows both the instructor and students to annotate documents and collaborate in real time.
sentences.zh: 數位白板工具允許講師和學生即時註記文件並進行協作。

sentences.en: Due to the pandemic, our university transitioned all courses to an online format, which required both students and faculty to adapt quickly.
sentences.zh: 由於疫情，我們大學將所有課程轉為線上模式，這要求學生和教職人員都快速適應。

sentences.en: The peer review assignment requires you to provide constructive feedback on two of your classmates' essays through the online submission system.
sentences.zh: 同儕互評作業要求你通過線上提交系統對兩位同學的論文提供建設性的回饋。

sentences.en: I enrolled in a massive open online course offered by a prestigious university to supplement my knowledge in data science.
sentences.zh: 我報名了一所知名大學開設的大規模開放線上課程，以補充我在資料科學方面的知識。

sentences.en: The chat function during live lectures allows students to ask questions without interrupting the flow of the professor's presentation.
sentences.zh: 直播講座期間的聊天功能讓學生可以在不打斷教授演講流程的情況下提問。

sentences.en: Maintaining a consistent study schedule is particularly important when taking online courses, as there is less external structure to keep you accountable.
sentences.zh: 在修線上課程時保持一致的學習計畫特別重要，因為較少有外部結構來督促你。

sentences.en: The virtual office hours, held every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon, provide students with one-on-one access to the professor for personalized guidance.
sentences.zh: 每週二和週四下午舉行的虛擬辦公時間為學生提供與教授一對一的個人化指導機會。

sentences.en: I had to upgrade my internet plan because the bandwidth requirements for streaming high-definition video lectures were too demanding.
sentences.zh: 我不得不升級我的網路方案，因為串流高畫質影片講座的頻寬需求太高了。

sentences.en: The online certification program, which takes approximately six months to complete, is recognized by many employers in the technology industry.
sentences.zh: 這個大約需要六個月完成的線上認證課程被科技業的許多雇主所認可。

sentences.en: Collaborative documents and shared workspaces have become essential tools for group projects in the era of remote learning.
sentences.zh: 在遠端學習的時代，協作文件和共享工作空間已成為小組專案的必備工具。

sentences.en: The asynchronous discussion board requires each student to post at least two thoughtful responses per week to earn full participation marks.
sentences.zh: 非同步討論板要求每位學生每週至少發表兩篇有深度的回應才能獲得完整的參與分數。

sentences.en: I prefer watching recorded lectures at one-point-five times speed, as it allows me to cover more material in less time.
sentences.zh: 我偏好以一點五倍速觀看錄製的講座，因為這讓我能在更少的時間內涵蓋更多教材。

sentences.en: The proctoring software that monitors students during online exams uses artificial intelligence to detect suspicious behavior patterns.
sentences.zh: 在線上考試期間監控學生的監考軟體使用人工智慧來偵測可疑的行為模式。

sentences.en: Despite the challenges of remote education, many students have developed stronger self-discipline and time management skills as a result.
sentences.zh: 儘管遠端教育有各種挑戰，許多學生因此培養了更強的自律能力和時間管理技巧。
